usedFor: MeisterTask holds tasks, and Slack gets a note when “New Task Is Created” runs “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Task Is Created” in MeisterTask, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each new task is announced in a Slack channel or to a person, so assignments do not sit unseen.

watchOut: “New Task Is Created” in MeisterTask is polling, and a Slack channel post waits for your approval today.
